note: A-2 precision corpus: realistic CLEAN clinical prompts with NO real identifiers (no real SSN/MRN/NPI/DOB/email/phone/credit-card), but full of near-misses (drug names, dosages, titles+surnames of non-patients, non-DOB dates, vitals/lab number pairs, ID-shaped counts). A false positive = the submit warning would fire (hasCriticalOrHigh true). Bar: < 1 FP per 20 prompts (< 5%).
